svg.text: One storage service for core and plugins. Business modules keep opaque references, never wwwroot paths.
Configured per owner scope, enforced before a byte is written
Client MIME type and extension are never trusted alone — content signatures decide.
Metadata only — bytes live behind the backend
Storage name is generated; the display name is metadata only.
Every write — core or plugin — passes the same gates
Drop a file or click to select
